summary.text: Elle Nguyen is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 41-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Janice Zahn (D).
Ballotpedia lists her as a real estate investor with a law degree from Seattle University.

paragraphs.text: Elle Nguyen earned a bachelor's degree from Regent University in 2010, a graduate degree from Regent in 2012, and a J.D. from Seattle University in 2016.
Her career experience includes working as a real estate investor.
Nguyen ran for Washington House District 41-Position 2 in 2022 and was eliminated in the August 2, 2022 primary, in which incumbent My-Linh Thai and Al Rosenthal advanced.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she was leaving a 24-year business career to run and described herself as a widowed mother of two.
Her stated 2022 key messages were economic recovery, public safety, and the educational system, and she named affordable housing, economic recovery and election integrity as policy interests.
